title: Asset and Protocol
author: Isandro Voss
blurb: Freya Yarrow, a financial-crimes investigator drowning in clean money, works cases no one wants attributed. But when every record of a flight vanishes while it's still in the air, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident before the markets open in Frankfurt.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
